| Use 2 Force to deploy on any AT-AT. May fire during a battle at same or adjacent site. May select a target only at an adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Vehicle hit if destiny +2 &gt; armor or maneuver. Starfighter hit if destiny &gt; 3. Character hit if destiny +1 &gt; ability. || Use 2 Force to deploy on {{Errata hl|1=your}} AT-AT. May {{Errata hl|1=target}} a {{Errata hl|1=starfighter (use 3 as defense value), character, creature or vehicle}} at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. {{Errata hl|1=Add 1 if targeting a character or creature, 2 if a vehicle. Target}} hit if {{Errata hl|1=total}} destiny > {{Errata hl|1=defense value.}}
